subject: gk
question: What is the primary purpose of ISRO's GSAT-20 (GSAT-N2) satellite ?

options.text: It provides navigation services across the Indian subcontinent.
It monitors weather patterns over the Indian Ocean.
It delivers high-speed broadband services using Ka-band across India.
It is designed for Earth observation and remote sensing.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It delivers high-speed broadband services using Ka-band across India.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The GSAT-20 satellite is part of ISRO's high-throughput communication satellite program aimed at improving internet connectivity across India.
 
• It uses advanced Ka-band frequency for delivering high-speed broadband services, ensuring enhanced communication capabilities.
 
• GSAT-20 is designed to cater to the growing demand for digital connectivity in remote and underserved areas of the country.
 
• With its high-throughput capabilities, GSAT-20 supports applications such as telemedicine, e-learning, e-governance, and other digital services.
 
• The satellite plays a crucial role in India's Digital India initiative by bridging the digital divide and providing internet access to rural and remote regions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: Navigation services across the Indian subcontinent**
 
 
• Navigation satellites like the NAVIC (Navigation with Indian Constellation) are specifically designed to provide accurate positioning and timing services across the Indian region.
 
• GSAT-20 is not used for navigation; instead, satellites like IRNSS (Indian Regional Navigation Satellite System) fulfill this purpose.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: Monitors weather patterns over the Indian Ocean**
 
 
• Weather monitoring and forecasting are handled by satellites such as INSAT-3DR and INSAT-3D, which provide meteorological data and observations.
 
• GSAT-20 does not serve this function as it is a high-throughput communication satellite focused on broadband services.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: Earth observation and remote sensing**
 
 
• Earth observation satellites like Cartosat, RISAT, and Oceansat are used for remote sensing, agricultural mapping, water resource management, and disaster monitoring.
 
• GSAT-20 is not designed for Earth observation; its primary role is communication and broadband services.
 
 
 
• **Main Theme: ISRO's GSAT Series**
 
 
• ISRO's GSAT series satellites are primarily focused on communication services, including DTH broadcasting, VSAT services, and broadband connectivity.
 
• These satellites play a vital role in providing digital connectivity and supporting India's technological and communication infrastructure.
